comments.author: yepitsme
comments.body_html:
Hey HOT DOG, as someone attempting to finish a large mod akin to some on the “featured” list (except for one quick mod to add points manually to whatever skill of 4 categories as you so wish more like a traditional RPG) the literal last thing I’d want to do is come off sirley so please note my comment is as constructive as I can be with my limited social skills lol.

But the Saiga 9 is just a civilian variant of the military [saiga] which already has full auto capability. This feels akin to making the vepr 209 full auto even though there is already an AKM.

Perhaps try adding other functionality, like a new item that is a trigger box that can be dropped in to add 2 or even 3 shot burst to make it more than just removing a civilian variant of a machine pistol/SMG and having x2 military variants with full auto.

Good luck on your journey to fantastic mod creation and PM me if you ever want to attempt to do something more sophisticated with another person, I can always use someone to assist in JSON making and server side mod’s!

Take care and good luck!

comments.author: HOT DOG (Mr. Fun Switch)
comments.body_html: I made this solely to use the Zenit Sport 3 rail system on a non-semi-weapon. Saiga is a company, not a weapon, the military version of the Saiga-9 is the PP-19 Viyitaz, the in-game Viyitaz doesn’t allow a longer barrel which is why the Saiga-9 is just a long Viyitaz. Thank you.

comments.author: Lockesly
comments.body_html: Hotdog I have to ask.. With this addition.. does that make/allow npc’s to use it as a full auto? I don’t recall them ever using the STM-9 in full auto with the mod for that weapon. But it’s also not a weapon they spawn with a lot soooo hard to tell. Asking the same about the Tx-15 as well.

comments.author: HOT DOG (Mr. Fun Switch)
comments.body_html: Yes, the STM-9 mod and the SAG AK mod do this! I’m unsure how to limit them to semi-auto if that’s what you’re looking for, my apologies.

comments.author: Lockesly
comments.body_html:
Nah wasn’t looking to limit. I just didn’t know.. I’m perfectly fine with them having full auto. I just didn’t know if it was giggle switch for me.. but not for the npc.

But also.. Good job. I always wondered why the Saiga 9 couldn’t be made full auto in the workbench etc..

My question is.. how do you make guns burst fire? I assume it’s a coding swap. I’d like to see the Tavor/XM9 bullpups in a burst fire.. just for pulse rifle fun.

Or if your fan of rare stuff.. the Beretta auto 9.. AKA Robocops pistol. that’d be fun.
